classification.difficultyReason: Reverse each composite horizontal transformation by choosing substitutions that remove the offset, reflection and scale in a valid order, restoring the argument to x.

content.prompt: For each of the following, describe a sequence of transformations that would restore it to $y=f(x)$.

answer.short: Translate left by $\frac12$ unit, then dilate horizontally by a factor of $2$.
answer.worked:
Translate left by $\frac12$ unit, replacing $x$ by $x+\frac12$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(2\left(x+\frac12\right)-1\right)\\y&=f(2x).\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by a factor of $2$, replacing $x$ by $\frac{x}{2}$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(2\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)\right)\\y&=f(x).\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Translate left by $\frac23$ unit, reflect in the $y$-axis, then dilate horizontally by a factor of $3$.
answer.worked:
Translate left by $\frac23$ unit, replacing $x$ by $x+\frac23$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(2-3\left(x+\frac23\right)\right)\\y&=f(-3x).\end{align*}$$
Reflect in the $y$-axis, replacing $x$ by $-x$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f(-3(-x))\\y&=f(3x).\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by a factor of $3$, replacing $x$ by $\frac{x}{3}$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(3\left(\frac{x}{3}\right)\right)\\y&=f(x).\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Translate left by $3$ units, then dilate horizontally by a factor of $\frac13$.
answer.worked:
Translate left by $3$ units, replacing $x$ by $x+3$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(\frac{x+3}{3}-1\right)\\y&=f\left(\frac{x}{3}\right).\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by a factor of $\frac13$, replacing $x$ by $3x$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(\frac{3x}{3}\right)\\y&=f(x).\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Translate left by $1$ unit, then dilate horizontally by a factor of $\frac13$.
answer.worked:
Translate left by $1$ unit, replacing $x$ by $x+1$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(\frac{(x+1)-1}{3}\right)\\y&=f\left(\frac{x}{3}\right).\end{align*}$$
Dilate horizontally by a factor of $\frac13$, replacing $x$ by $3x$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=f\left(\frac{3x}{3}\right)\\y&=f(x).\end{align*}$$
